messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Omeprazole can cause diarrhea, which may be a sign of a new infection.
If you have diarrhea that is watery or bloody, call your doctor before using anti-diarrhea medicine.
Triplet: ["diarrhea", "may indicate", "new infection"]

The relation 'may indicate' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or symptom may be a sign or indicator of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
D. 'caused by': The subject condition or symptom is caused by the object condition or factor.
E. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
